embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: Conflict-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation in Aligned Action Spaces for Cross-Game Generalization
fields.value: likely Tencent's Lightspeed Studios, not independently confirmed beyond the paper's own "LIGHTSPEED" affiliation label); other co-authors at HKUST(GZ)/HKUST (flag) — The authors target zero-shot cross-game generalization: consolidating several single-game vision-language-model (VLM) experts into one model that can control unseen games from raw pixels with no target-game training.

fields.name: BlockAlign: Preference Optimization for Trajectory-Distilled Video Generation
fields.value: Alibaba Group — BlockAlign is a preference-optimization framework for aligning few-step, "trajectory-distilled" video generators (e.g., Parallel Decoding Distillation and Parametric Trajectory Distillation models) without teacher fine-tuning or re-distillation.

fields.name: The Flip Test: Video World Models Fail to Learn the World State
fields.value: Google DeepMind; Alex Dimakis: UC Berkeley) — The authors introduce FlipTest, a counterfactual benchmark that probes whether video world models actually track physical world state rather than just drawing plausible pixels.

fields.name: WA-JEPA: Goal-Aware Predictive Feedback Action Refinement for a World-Action Model
fields.value: Hikvision Research Institute; other co-authors are Harbin Institute of Technology and Anhui Polytechnic University) (flag) — WA-JEPA is a JEPA-based "world-action" model that generates robot action proposals and then iteratively refines them using the model's own latent predictions of future scenes, instead of searching over candidate action sequences.

fields.name: ResWAM: Learning What Changes, Not What Stays, for World-Action Models
fields.value: exact per-author mapping to Cisco/IBM was not clearly resolvable from the rendered HTML, but both corporate affiliations appear on the author block. (flag) — The paper addresses world-action models (WAMs) — vision-language-action policies augmented with future prediction — which the authors argue waste capacity supervising mostly-static full future observations instead of task-relevant motion.

fields.name: Prepare Lighter and Faster for Open-Vocabulary Queries: A Query-Wise 3D Segmenter for Gaussian Splatting
fields.value: Qualcomm; Nhat-Quynh Le-Pham — The paper presents a training-free, query-driven framework for open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation directly on pretrained 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, avoiding the expensive preprocessing and per-scene training of prior methods.

fields.name: GameWM: Toward Next-Generation Video Games with Interaction-Centric World Models
fields.value: Tencent — The authors propose GameWM, a design for next-generation video games that splits responsibilities between a lightweight "engine" that keeps exact rules/state/camera/world-layout and a generative video model ("VM") that renders the look of the world and the detail of player interactions.

fields.name: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
fields.value: China Telecom; Li is corresponding author) (flag) — TelePhysica is a closed-loop, agentic pipeline that reconstructs a physically simulatable 3D scene from a single photo and uses the resulting physics rollouts to condition video diffusion models.

fields.name: SceneAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Portable Game Scene Generation
fields.value: Tencent — SceneAgent is a multi-agent framework for generating 3D game scenes that can be ported across different game-engine backends without rebuilding the generation pipeline from scratch.

fields.name: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 Technical Report
fields.value: Meituan; no arXiv HTML version exists to independently verify affiliations, so this relies on the author-field attribution rather than an HTML affiliation block) (flag) — This is a technical report on LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6, an audio-driven avatar video generation model that builds on the team's prior 1.5 version, aiming to improve lip-audio synchronization, natural head/body motion, and visual consistency over long generated sequences.

fields.name: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agents
fields.value: miHoYo — Gamer is a generalist vision-language-action agent framework built by miHoYo's Honkai AI R&D Team for long-horizon, real-time play across both 2D interfaces and 3D open-world games, including miHoYo's own title Honkai: Star Rail (HSR).

fields.name: Découpage: Directorial Audio-Visual Control for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation
fields.value: Ant Group (affiliation listed for the author group alongside HKUST and Zhejiang University; the HTML rendering lost the footnote markers linking individual names to institutions, so the specific Ant Group author (flag) — DECOUPAGE is a screenplay-driven framework for generating long, multi-shot, multi-character videos with synchronized but independently-timed audio and visual tracks, addressing cinematic effects like dialogue that bridges across cuts (J-/L-cuts) and deliberate silences.

fields.name: Split-and-scale Latent 3D Representations
fields.value: Apple; paper states all funding came from Apple — Apple researchers propose "split-and-scale," a way to boost the effective capacity of latent 3D representations at inference time without retraining a larger tokenizer.

fields.name: Rethinking Actions: Continuity-Aware Priors for World-Model Planning
fields.value: Alibaba Group; (other authors are at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications; Bin Fang's affiliation is ambiguous in the HTML, with an Ant Group email domain visible — The paper studies whether action proposals that better respect the temporal continuity of expert action sequences improve goal-directed planning with learned visual world models.
